pages.text: It is said that during the age of legends, the Piglins waged war against the Overworld. After their defeat and decline, they left behind $(l)ruins that no longer shine with their former glory$(). Some claim that the Piglins still preserve a scroll recording their ancient knowledge, held in the hands of $(l)certain Mages among the Piglins$().
It is said that these mages can be summoned within $(l)Bastion Remnants$().
